start_linked: ReMind is connected. Send a message here, mention me in a group, or use inline mode in any chat.
start_unlinked: Connect this Telegram profile to a ReMind account first. Sign in or register on the website with Telegram, then return and press /start.
help: Send a message for a full answer. In groups, mention the bot or reply to it. In any chat, type the bot username and a short question for an inline answer. Use /reset, /stop or /clear to clear the current conversation context.
settings: Telegram conversations are synchronized with ReMind and available through the Telegram chat-history filter.
new_chat: A new Telegram conversation has started.
context_reset: The current conversation context was cleared. You can start fresh.
not_connected: This Telegram profile is not connected to ReMind yet.
account_restricted: This ReMind account is currently restricted.
empty_question: Send a question after the command or in a new message.
unsupported_message: For now, send a text message.
generation_failed: I couldn't generate an answer right now. Please try again.
inline_result_description: Send this answer to the chat
inline_connect: Connect your ReMind account to use inline answers.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
